issues.on_page: Long-Term Compensated Absences, Less Current Obligations 999,000
issues.issue: Rules put compensated absences under accrued liabilities only when they are due soon. This noncurrent portion could go under other liabilities instead.

issues.on_page: Capital Contributions and Grants 516,103; Loss on disposal of capital assets (98,955)
issues.issue: The loss on disposal is a nonoperating expense line, and it was netted into other_financing instead of being listed as a disbursement. That is defensible (it is the signed sale-of-assets side) and the arithmetic holds: 516,103 - 98,955 = 417,148.
